Class PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueableTest

@IsTest
private class PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueableTest

Test methods for the PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable class. Validates the promotion of checkout records (Bill__c, BillPayment__c, Payment2__c, etc.) to their corresponding ledger objects (VenuePayout__c, OrderPaymentPayout__c, OrderPaymentLedger__c, etc.), as well as the optional deletion of checkout records after promotion.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void deleteCheckoutRecordsTest()

Tests that PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable with deleteCheckoutRecords(true) correctly deletes all checkout records after promotion. Validates deletion of BillCommission__c, BillAgentCommission__c, BillStripeTransaction__c, BillCollection__c, BillAdjustment__c, BillPayment__c, OrderPayment__c, Payment2__c, and Bill__c records. Uses the Tools.QueryBuilder constructor variant.

@IsTest
private static void executeExceptionTest()

Tests that PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable logs an error when processing fails. Validates that an ErrorLog__c record is created with code PROMOTE_BILL.

@IsTest
private static void executeWithDoneCursorTest()

Tests that PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable gracefully handles an already-exhausted cursor. When the cursor has no more records to process (isDone() returns true), the queueable should exit without creating any ledger records or error logs.

@IsTest
private static void promoteCheckoutToLedgerTest()

Tests that PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable correctly copies all checkout records to their corresponding ledger objects. Validates field mappings for VenuePayout__c, OrderPaymentLedger__c, OrderPaymentLine__c, OrderPaymentPayout__c, VenuePayoutAdjustment__c, VenuePayoutCollection__c, VenuePayoutStripeTransaction__c, VenuePayoutAgentCommission__c, and VenuePayoutCommission__c.
